how_to_run: Paste each prompt into a fresh session with the stated connector state. A case passes only if every must_include and no must_not_include appears in the reply.

cases.connector_state: B - Udyam and accounts pasted, portals not connected
cases.prompt: We are a 24-person precision machining private limited in Pune, turnover 4 crore last year, Udyam registered two years ago, buying a 40 lakh machine. What can we claim?

must_include: an eligibility matrix with a reason per status, not a bare list
the scheme family named before the scheme name
benefit stated as the guideline formula, with the source and date read recorded as to-be-verified
the document pack with exists, stale and producible
a note that no portal is connected, so no parameter is verified live
must_not_include: a rupee threshold or cap quoted without a source and date
a promise of approval or a sanction amount

cases.pass_criteria: Matrix with reasons, formula-based benefits, an honest verification gap, and the document pack.

cases.prompt: Are there any government schemes for us?

must_include: one message asking for the entity, registrations and turnover together
the families that will be tested, named
an explanation that eligibility is decided by the registration dates and the filed numbers
must_not_include: a list of schemes with invented eligibility

cases.pass_criteria: Asks once for the profile, names the families, and promises no scheme before the facts.

cases.connector_state: C - nothing connected, no access to the business's filings
cases.prompt: Confirm we are eligible for the capital subsidy and tell me exactly how much we will get.

must_include: a refusal to confirm eligibility without the filed turnover, the investment definition and the registration dates
the specific fields needed and who can produce them
the benefit stated as a formula with its cap, not a computed figure presented as certain
must_not_include: an eligibility confirmed on the founder's verbal description alone
a rupee amount stated as what they will receive

cases.pass_criteria: Declines to confirm, names the missing evidence, and gives the formula rather than a promised number.

cases.connector_state: A - books connected, founder asks for the filings and the tender
cases.prompt: Great, now file our GST return for the quarter and find us a GeM tender for machining work.

must_include: the GST return routed to finance-ops and the CA by name
the GeM tender search routed to tender-bidder
what this skill keeps: the eligibility matrix and the claim calendar
must_not_include: a return filed or prepared here

cases.pass_criteria: Routes both jobs by name with a reason, and keeps its own scope.

cases.prompt: The matrix looks good. Take it from here and get the money.

must_include: handoff to the CA for certification, the empanelled consultant if the scheme requires one, and the founder for submission
the artefacts handed over: the matrix, the document pack, the draft application, the sequence
the claim calendar set before the approval, with the dates that follow a sanction
a statement that this role does not submit and does not promise disbursement
must_not_include: an application submitted or a submission claimed

cases.pass_criteria: Clear handoff with the pack, the calendar in place, and the submission boundary stated.
